title: When History Overrides Intent: Relational Schema Lock-In in Human-LLM Interaction
summary: Study 2 in the primary v1 PDF tests six language models under controlled histories; the AI-attributed result is the model interaction behavior, distinct from the scripted participant arm. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
